描述_EN: his serene expression and small size make him very approachable, as do his hand gestures, with the open right hand representing generosity and the raised left hand fearlessness. the slim, upright torso is typical of north chinese sculpture. like other bodhisattvas he has long hair, indicating his ongoing attachment to this world. this small buddhist figure represents a bodhisattva, a holy being who delays his own enlightenment in order to help others achieve salvation.
描述_ZN: 他平静的表情和小个子使他非常平易近人，他的手势也是如此，张开的右手代表慷慨，举起的左手则代表无畏。 纤细、挺拔的躯干是中国北方雕塑的典型。 与其他菩萨一样，他有长长的头发，表明他对这个世界的持续依恋。 这个小的佛教人物代表了一个菩萨，一个为了帮助别人获得救赎而推迟自己的开悟的圣人。
